description: Estadísticas Generales del Puerto de Ensenada, Costa Azul y El Sauzal is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Ensenada, S.A de C.V (ASIPONA ENSENADA). Datos estadísticos generales, información mensual acumulada de la carga total operada en las terminales y muelles públicos a cargo de la Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Ensenada, S.A de C.V. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Ensenada, S.A de C.V (ASIPONA ENSENADA). Its tags are actividad marítima, asunto marítimo, barco, buque, gestión costera. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
